method: Size-first screening: exact byte equality after every completed compression. Raw records retain single-run CPU, elapsed time, RSS; no speed claim. Compact repeats stopped once disqualified by size.
memory_scope: Complete compression plus round-trip verification process, with compressor context retained during verification. This is not runtime memory or a direct production-packer RSS measurement.
limitations: Single screening run per candidate/input; compact repetitions stopped after size regression. Whole-process CPU and peak RSS include roundtrip. Host contention affects wall time.
experiment: Compression speed screening; candidates must not increase payload size
